::: {.callout-note title="Evidence"}
Unless marked otherwise, statements on this page are **source-verified** at
`3b4c05386e5a44d05633136ecbcf5dd067f70435`. File, workbook, permission, and
database behaviour is **environment-dependent** and requires Excel testing.
:::

## Workbook identity and portable paths

NADABAS registers a workbook by its file name without extension and stores its
folder separately. The source searches supported legacy and current Excel
extensions when opening a registered workbook. A path beginning with `!` is
resolved relative to the configured base path.

[`FileNameFunctions.bas`](https://github.com/statisticsnorway/nadabas/blob/3b4c05386e5a44d05633136ecbcf5dd067f70435/vba/modules/FileNameFunctions.bas)
provides the conversion helpers:

| Function | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| `GetPath`, `GetPath2` | Return a folder with or without a trailing backslash. |
| `GetFilename` | Return the file name and extension. |
| `GetFileExtension` | Return the extension. |
| `DropFileType` | Remove the extension. |
| `DropBasePath` | Replace the configured base-path prefix with `!` where applicable. |
| `AppendBasePath` | Resolve a leading `!` back to the current base path. |

`TestBasePath` and `getBasepath` are implemented in `cmdBaseFolder`, not in
`FileNameFunctions` as stated in the retained draft. Portable paths reduce the
number of stored absolute paths, but moving a deployment still requires a
verified base-path update and file-access test.

## Opening and tracking workbooks

[`cmdOpenWorkbooks.bas`](https://github.com/statisticsnorway/nadabas/blob/3b4c05386e5a44d05633136ecbcf5dd067f70435/vba/modules/cmdOpenWorkbooks.bas)
opens `frmOpenWorkbooks`, remembers the last selected tab and item, and delegates
to `DoOpenWorkbook`.

The opening flow:

1. Resolve the registered folder and locate a supported Excel file extension.
2. If multiple matching files exist, ask the user to choose; if the workbook is
   already open, activate it.
3. Evaluate file read-only state, user permissions, reservation, transfer, and
   export status.
4. Open unavailable or restricted workbooks read-only where the source allows,
   and populate `clsWBData` from `clsWorkBookInfo`.
5. For ordinary opens, optionally test whether recorded source workbooks have
   newer saved data than the workbook's last-get timestamp.

Exact extension selection, file locking, external links, and concurrent-user
behaviour require runtime tests on supported storage.

## Registering, managing, and reserving

[`cmdRegisterBook.bas`](https://github.com/statisticsnorway/nadabas/blob/3b4c05386e5a44d05633136ecbcf5dd067f70435/vba/modules/cmdRegisterBook.bas)
uses `frmRegisterBook` to collect title and group information, validates the
base-path policy, and persists workbook metadata.

`frmManageWorkBooks` contains most management implementation:

| Action | Source behaviour |
|---|---|
| Rename | Rename the file and update references in `Permissions`, `BatchList`, `Documents`, `DataLinks`, the `Workbooks` object, and key-family provenance columns. |
| Replace | Select and validate a replacement workbook, update name/path references, and remove data attributed to the old workbook where the form requests that operation. |
| Delete | Remove the workbook and related permission, batch, document, data-link, and key-family provenance records. |
| Edit metadata | Reuse `frmRegisterBook` to update title and group. |

These are multi-object operations implemented as VBA-issued SQL statements.
Atomicity and rollback are not established by static review; interrupted rename,
replace, and delete operations need recovery tests.

`ReserveWorkbook` writes current user, timestamp, and `Status = "Reserved"` to
the workbook record. `FreeWorkbook` clears the reservation. Other users may be
limited to read-only access. Reservation is application coordination, not proof
of a database lock or file-system lock.

## Workbook definition ranges

| Named range | Role in source |
|---|---|
| `DBLinks` | Rows describing base-database data areas and load/save modes. |
| `ExchLinks` | Equivalent definitions used with an exchange database. |
| `DBGlobals` | Workbook area populated with database global values before applicable operations. |
| `Descriptions` | Optional description metadata associated with `DBLinks` rows. |
| `DBSourceFiles` | Hidden workbook provenance used to detect newer source data. |

Definitions refer to named data areas and supporting `DBDef` and `TabDef`
ranges. The exact column contract depends on definition type and is validated by
`ScanTableDefTest` and `ScanTableDefs`; it should be documented as a separate,
test-backed interface specification before external tools generate definitions.

## Validation and scan results

[`TestDefinitions`](https://github.com/statisticsnorway/nadabas/blob/3b4c05386e5a44d05633136ecbcf5dd067f70435/vba/modules/ScanTableDefTest.bas#L39)
checks workbook definitions before design, load, save, and batch operations. The
module validates range presence and shape, modes, formulas, key combinations,
data types, classifications, correspondence use, `WHERE` values, and period
rules. The exact checks vary by definition type.

[`ScanTableDef`](https://github.com/statisticsnorway/nadabas/blob/3b4c05386e5a44d05633136ecbcf5dd067f70435/vba/modules/ScanTableDefs.bas#L8)
fills a `clsScanTableDefResults` object. That object carries SQL fragments,
operation type, row and column identifiers, ranges, field information, and
scan status used by load/save routines.

Validation is substantial but does not prove that all malformed workbooks,
SQL fragments, locale-specific values, or database failures are handled safely.

## Load or import

```{mermaid}
sequenceDiagram
  actor User
  participant Entry as "Load_data or Importdata"
  participant Validate as "TestDefinitions and ScanTableDef"
  participant DB as "CurrentDB through ADO"
  participant WB as "Workbook ranges"

  User->>Entry: Start load/import
  Entry->>WB: Select DBLinks or ExchLinks
  Entry->>Validate: Validate definitions and period rules
  Validate-->>Entry: Scan result and SQL
  Entry->>DB: Open and query matching rows
  DB-->>Entry: Values and provenance
  Entry->>WB: Compare and update target cells
  Entry->>DB: Update last-get/data-link metadata where applicable
  Entry->>DB: Close operation-level database use
  Entry-->>User: Statistics, marks, log, or error message
```

The implementation is in
[`cmdLoadData_ImportData.bas`](https://github.com/statisticsnorway/nadabas/blob/3b4c05386e5a44d05633136ecbcf5dd067f70435/vba/modules/cmdLoadData_ImportData.bas).
It scans each applicable definition, builds database queries, uses bookmark
helpers for row lookup, compares returned values with target cells, records
changed or missing cells, and maintains last-get/source information where the
workflow applies.

The SQL example in the retained draft is illustrative only. Generated SQL must
be reviewed from the current scan routines; it is not a stable public query
contract.

## Save or export

```{mermaid}
sequenceDiagram
  actor User
  participant Entry as "Save_data or ExportData"
  participant Validate as "TestDefinitions and ScanTableDef"
  participant WB as "Workbook ranges"
  participant DB as "CurrentDB through ADO"

  User->>Entry: Start save/export
  Entry->>Validate: Validate definitions and conflicts
  Entry->>WB: Read PUTDB or MIXED cells
  Entry->>DB: Find existing dimension-key rows
  Entry->>DB: Insert or update value and provenance
  Entry->>DB: Update last-put/workbook metadata
  Entry->>DB: Close operation-level database use
  Entry->>WB: Update dirty state and optional workbook save
  Entry-->>User: Statistics, log, or error message
```

The implementation is in
[`cmdSaveData_ExportData.bas`](https://github.com/statisticsnorway/nadabas/blob/3b4c05386e5a44d05633136ecbcf5dd067f70435/vba/modules/cmdSaveData_ExportData.bas).
It validates definitions, tests existing ownership/provenance, compares cells
with keyed database rows, inserts or updates data, and records workbook and
operation metadata. Some conflicts can be presented differently for an
administrator.

`cmdLoadAndSave.LoadAndSaveData` composes the two operations and applies user
settings controlling workbook saves. Transaction scope, concurrent writes,
rollback, and administrator override semantics remain **unknown** until tested
against each supported database engine.

## Linked documents and generated reports

Documents are metadata records, not binary content stored by the VBA-defined
schema. `cmdManageDocuments.RegisterDocument` and `frmRegisterDoc` store a file
name, portable path, and association level:

1. global;
2. workbook group; or
3. individual workbook.

Non-administrators are constrained by the form to the active workbook level.
The `DocsInBase` setting controls whether a path outside the base folder is
rejected or may be accepted after confirmation.

`frmOpenDocuments` presents available global, group, and workbook documents.
Excel file extensions are opened through `Workbooks.Open`; other types are
passed to the Windows shell integration. Paths and file types therefore cross a
security boundary and must be treated as untrusted configuration.

`cmdDocumentation.SelectReport` opens `frmDocumentation`, where report-specific
queries and workbook output are implemented. The retained draft lists reports
for classifications, correspondences, batches, key families, workbooks, data
areas, and dimensions. Treat the actual form code as the source until each
report has a repeatable output test.

## Required runtime scenarios

- open a registered workbook from NADABAS and from File Explorer;
- open reserved, permission-limited, already-open, missing, and read-only files;
- rename, replace, delete, and recover after an injected failure;
- load and save `GETDB`, `PUTDB`, `MIXED`, exchange, batch, missing-value, and
  conflict cases;
- verify last-get, last-put, source, dirty, and reservation state;
- open allowed and disallowed linked document types and paths;
- repeat with supported Access and SQL Server configurations.
